repo_notes.content: GeneralsX is a community-driven cross-platform port of Command & Conquer: Generals Zero Hour (2003) for Linux and macOS, modernizing a legacy Windows DirectX 8 + Miles Sound codebase to a modern 64-bit stack (SDL3 + DXVK + OpenAL/MiniAudio + FFmpeg). The primary target is GeneralsXZH (Zero Hour expansion in GeneralsMD/), with GeneralsX (base game in Generals/) as secondary. The codebase (~500k+ LOC) preserves retail gameplay and simulation determinism while modernizing the underlying platform layer.
repo_notes.author: GeneralsX Team

repo_notes.content: Platform isolation is strictly enforced: all platform-specific code must reside in Core/GameEngineDevice/ and Core/Libraries/Source/Platform/. Direct Win32, Cocoa, or unabstracted POSIX calls are strictly forbidden in game simulation logic (GameLogic/). SDL3 serves as the unified windowing, input, and platform abstraction layer across all target platforms.
repo_notes.author: GeneralsX Team

repo_notes.content: Multiplayer strategy: The legacy GameSpy online backend is discontinued and superseded by Next-Gen Multiplayer (NGMP / GeneralsOnline). Singleplayer campaigns, Skirmish (vs AI), and LAN multiplayer must remain fully functional. GameSpy online compatibility is not required and must not block NGMP development. Active client integration lives under GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameNetwork/GeneralsOnline/ with protocol references in references/GameClient and references/GameServer.
repo_notes.author: GeneralsX Team

repo_notes.content: Cross-platform determinism between Linux x86_64 and macOS ARM64 is critical to prevent sync crashes (desyncs). Key rules: (1) Use deterministic WWMath equivalents for all math functions (WWMath::SqrtOrigin, SinTrig, CosTrig, Atan2Origin, etc.); (2) ScopedFPUGuard must wrap GameLogic::update(), audio callbacks, and mouse picking; (3) Guard all divisions against NaN/Inf integer cast divergences (WWMath::Div_FixNaN); (4) Disable FMA contraction (-ffp-contract=off); (5) Use scripts/qa/parse_deep_crc.py to diagnose deep CRC memory buffer dumps.
repo_notes.author: GeneralsX Team

repo_notes.content: Audio stack parity: GeneralsX maintains dual cross-platform modern audio backends — OpenAL and MiniAudio — replacing the legacy Miles Sound System. Any new audio features or bug fixes implemented in one backend must be replicated in the other to maintain strict feature parity.
repo_notes.author: GeneralsX Team

repo_notes.content: Build system uses CMake with presets defined in CMakePresets.json. Active release targets are 'linux64-deploy' and 'macos-vulkan'. Windows modern support is tracked under 'mingw-w64-i686' (Docker cross-compilation) and issue #29. DXVK source of truth is the fork branch generalsx-macos-v2.6 in references/fbraz3-dxvk. Scripts are structured under scripts/build/, scripts/qa/, scripts/env/, and scripts/tooling/.
repo_notes.author: GeneralsX Team

pages.title: Project Overview
pages.purpose: High-level overview of GeneralsX: vision, scope, platform targets (Linux, macOS, Windows MinGW backlog), non-negotiable architectural constraints (retail compatibility, platform isolation, single codebase), and active development priorities.

pages.title: Repository Structure
pages.purpose: Document the top-level directory layout: GeneralsMD/ (Zero Hour, primary), Generals/ (base game, secondary), Core/ (shared engine), cmake/ (modular build scripts), scripts/ (build, QA, tooling), references/ (fbraz3-dxvk, GameClient, GameServer), resources/, flatpak/, assets/, and docs/.

pages.title: Build System & Presets
pages.purpose: Document CMakePresets.json and primary presets: linux64-deploy, linux64-testing, macos-vulkan, mingw-w64-i686, vc6, and win32. Explain modular cmake/ configuration files (dx8.cmake, sdl3.cmake, openal.cmake, miniaudio.cmake, ngmp.cmake, FindFFmpeg.cmake) and Docker containerized build workflows.

pages.title: Scripts & Tooling Reference
pages.purpose: Reference guide for scripts/: scripts/build/linux/ (docker-configure-linux.sh, docker-build-linux-zh.sh, build-linux-flatpak.sh, deploy-linux-zh.sh), scripts/build/macos/ (build-macos-zh.sh, deploy-macos-zh.sh, bundle-macos-zh.sh), scripts/qa/ (docker-smoke-test-zh.sh, parse_deep_crc.py), and scripts/tooling/ (generate_windows_icons.py, cpp maintenance).

pages.title: Core Engine Architecture
pages.purpose: Document Core/ shared libraries: GameEngine/ (simulation loop, subsystems, audio/video abstractions), GameEngineDevice/ (platform rendering device and OS abstractions), and Libraries/ (WWVegas, deterministic math, containers, STLPort compatibility).

pages.title: Platform Abstraction & Device Layer
pages.purpose: Document Core/GameEngineDevice/ and Core/Libraries/Source/Platform/: platform isolation rules, SDL3 windowing and event handling, threading primitives, and cross-platform compatibility headers (windows_compat.h). Prohibit native Win32/Cocoa calls in game logic.

pages.title: Rendering & DXVK Integration
pages.purpose: Document the W3D rendering engine and DXVK DirectX 8 to Vulkan translation layer across Linux, macOS (via MoltenVK to Metal), and Windows. Explain the fork source-of-truth policy in references/fbraz3-dxvk (branch generalsx-macos-v2.6) and FetchContent build mechanics.

pages.title: Audio Subsystem (OpenAL & MiniAudio)
pages.purpose: Document the modern cross-platform audio architectures replacing Miles Sound System: OpenAL and MiniAudio implementations. Detail the strict parity requirement between both backends, 3D sound positioning, audio threading, and FPU isolation.

pages.title: Video Subsystem (FFmpeg)
pages.purpose: Document the video playback subsystem replacing legacy Bink Video with modern FFmpeg (cmake/FindFFmpeg.cmake and GameClient video player) for intro cinematics and campaign cutscenes.

pages.title: Next-Gen Multiplayer (NGMP / GeneralsOnline)
pages.purpose: Document the Next-Gen Multiplayer (NGMP / GeneralsOnline) client integration under GeneralsMD/Code/GameEngine/Source/GameNetwork/GeneralsOnline/. Explain REST API conventions (/env/dev/contract/1/ prefix, Bearer token auth), WebSocket routing via integer msg_id, room registration, P2P network synchronization, and reference implementations (references/GameClient, references/GameServer).

pages.title: Cross-Platform Determinism & Anti-Desync
pages.purpose: Comprehensive guide to simulation determinism between Linux x86_64 and macOS ARM64: deterministic math replacements in WWMath (SqrtOrigin, SinTrig, CosTrig, Atan2Origin, etc.), ScopedFPUGuard usage around logic updates and audio, NaN/Inf integer cast guards (WWMath::Div_FixNaN), disabling FMA contraction (-ffp-contract=off), and deep CRC diagnostics (scripts/qa/parse_deep_crc.py).

pages.title: Cross-Platform Port Strategy
pages.purpose: Architectural strategy for porting the legacy 32-bit DirectX 8 Windows game to modern 64-bit Linux and macOS: SDL3 everywhere, DXVK everywhere, OpenAL/MiniAudio parity, single codebase maintainability, and clean separation between platform abstractions and game simulation.

pages.title: Linux Platform
pages.purpose: Document Linux-specific build, packaging, and execution: linux64-deploy preset, Docker builds, native compilation, Flatpak bundle packaging (scripts/build/linux/build-linux-flatpak.sh), AppImage, case-sensitive filesystem requirements (fixIncludesCase.sh), and smoke testing.

pages.title: macOS Platform
pages.purpose: Document macOS Apple Silicon (ARM64) support: macos-vulkan preset, DXVK + MoltenVK Vulkan-to-Metal translation chain, native Meson configuration (cmake/meson-arm64-native.ini), Vulkan SDK requirements, and .app bundle packaging (scripts/build/macos/bundle-macos-zh.sh).

pages.title: Windows Modern Platform
pages.purpose: Document the modern Windows platform roadmap (issue #29): MinGW-w64 toolchain, mingw-w64-i686 Docker cross-compilation, planned windows64-deploy preset, SDL3/DXVK runtime, and multi-resolution executable icon generation (scripts/tooling/generate_windows_icons.py).

pages.title: Reference Repositories
pages.purpose: Document internal and external reference codebases: local references in references/ (fbraz3-dxvk, GameClient, GameServer) and upstream/historical references (TheSuperHackers upstream baseline, fighter19-dxvk-port for DXVK/SDL3, jmarshall-win64-modern for OpenAL/Win64).

pages.title: Zero Hour (GeneralsMD)
pages.purpose: Document GeneralsMD/ structure: primary development target GeneralsXZH, expansion-specific game logic, WinMain.cpp entry point, run-time data layout, and CMake target configuration.

pages.title: Generals Base Game
pages.purpose: Document Generals/ structure: secondary development target GeneralsX, base game codebase, and the backporting policy (platform/backend improvements and Core bugfixes are backported from Zero Hour, but expansion-specific game logic is not).

pages.title: Legacy Windows & Upstream Compatibility
pages.purpose: Document legacy Windows build targets (vc6, win32) for upstream alignment with TheSuperHackers: STLPort diffs, manual memory management (delete/delete[]), retail replay compatibility rules (RTS_BUILD_OPTION_DEBUG=OFF), and upstream merge conflict resolution strategies.

pages.title: Development Workflow & Standards
pages.purpose: Document day-to-day engineering practices: GeneralsX code annotation conventions (// GeneralsX @keyword author DD/MM/YYYY Description), Conventional Commits without '@' in the subject line, GitHub PR/issue workflows, and console logging conventions (fprintf(stderr)).

pages.title: Documentation Architecture
pages.purpose: Document docs/ hierarchy: monthly worklog diaries in docs/WORKLOG/YYYY-MM-DIARY.md (with standard AI disclosure note), active work notes in docs/WORKDIR/ (planning, reports, support, audit, lessons), and user documentation hosted in the GitHub Wiki with stubs in docs/HOWTO/.
